content.text: In Kenya, where Stripe is unavailable, selling ebooks online often seems impossible. But what if you could own the infrastructure, not rent it? With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell ebooks to international buyers without relying on platforms like Stripe. This guide shows you how to deploy a secure and scalable online store using Cloudflare infrastructure and blockchain-based payments.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When platforms like Stripe fail or restrict access, your online store is left hanging. But with a sovereign digital commerce stack, you own the infrastructure and can process payments directly. This means you're not dependent on a single platform, and you can scale your store without worrying about restrictions. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, you can create a secure and flexible online store that's tailored to your needs.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few key components. First, you'll need a domain name and a website hosting platform like Cloudflare Pages. Next, you'll need a backend logic platform like Cloudflare Workers to handle payment processing and order management. Finally, you'll need a database like Supabase to store customer and order information. Once you have these components, you can start building your online store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To accept payments from international buyers, you'll need a payment gateway that supports cryptocurrency transactions. NOWPayments is a great option, as it offers a 0.5% fee and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. With NOWPayments, you can set up a secure payment pipeline that automatically verifies transactions on the blockchain. For file delivery, you can use Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive to host your ebooks and deliver them directly to customers.
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you own the infrastructure, not rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your payment and delivery pipeline set up, it's time to go live with your online store. Deploy your Cloudflare Pages site, configure your Cloudflare Workers backend, and set up your Supabase database. Once you've completed these steps, you can start processing transactions with NOWPayments. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment will be verified on the blockchain, and you can deliver the ebook directly to their email.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your online store is up and running, you can scale your infrastructure to meet growing demand. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can add new products, customers, and payment methods as needed. You can also configure your Cloudflare Pages site to handle high traffic and prevent downtime. By scaling your infrastructure, you can ensure that your online store remains secure, fast, and reliable.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. Local exchanges like Patricia in Nigeria and similar platforms in other markets provide additional options. The conversion takes 20-30 minutes on average and costs 2-5% — significantly less than PayPal's international transfer fees. The sovereign stack provides the storefront, the automated delivery, and the order management. NOWPayments handles the payment verification. P2P handles the conversion. Together, this is a complete operational pipeline from digital product sale to local currency in your hands.
Cloudflare infrastructure and blockchain-based payments offer a secure and scalable solution for online stores.
